reviews.text: Excellent veterinarian, available, caring, competent and extremely kind.

Dr. Carlos was very courteous and attentive during my puppy's health check-up and vaccination, also arranging for Calvin's registration with the companion animal information system (SIAC) – an essential step to present to the Parish Council. He will certainly be our family veterinarian.
Excellent veterinarian, thank you for taking care of my dog ​​Romeo.
Excellent, the doctor is super friendly and gentle with the animals, and the hours are fantastic.
The veterinarian was very attentive and friendly.

A veterinarian who inspires a lot of confidence; he consulted and treated one of our cats with great care. Empathetic with the owners, he explains the pathology calmly, realistically, and transparently. We left the office feeling accompanied by a professional who will help us provide the greatest possible comfort to our cat at this stage of its life, which reassures us.
Excellent. Spectacular doctor, very attentive to our boys. 😊 …
Miel loves visiting Carlos; he's incredibly kind and takes great care of the animals he looks after. He helps us with all our questions.
